'''Bikers''' are a recurring enemy in the Ninja Gaiden series, starting with ''[[Ninja Gaiden (Arcade)]]''.
[[File:Ninja Gaiden ARC enemy biker.png|148x148px]]

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:BikerNES1.png|80px]]

Bikers are the first enemy encountered in the game, first appearing in [[Galesburg|Act 1-1]]. They slowly march in one direction, swinging their bat every now and then and turning around if they reach a ledge/wall. They only deal 1 point of damage on contact, and are easily defeated in one hit by any attack.
